In a statement posted on X, the UKMTO said on Monday, October 5, that the incident occurred about 11 nautical miles …

candidates.title: Cyberfraudster from Maharashtra held for duping in Adilabad
candidates.excerpt: A Maharashtra man was arrested in Adilabad for allegedly cheating a local resident of Rs 73,279 while posing as a bank official. Police said the accused claimed during interrogation that he had duped around 150 people in Telangana and Goa and collected Rs 95.33 lakh

candidates.title: Spain’s Prime Minister calls early election after housing crisis defeat
candidates.excerpt: The defeat infuriated those protesting the country’s increasingly expensive housing market and underscored the difficulties his minority coalition government faces in passing legislation

candidates.title: Hyderabad cybercrime: Retired employee loses Rs 38 lakh in honey-trap scam
candidates.excerpt: A 70-year-old retired employee from Hyderabad was allegedly cheated of Rs 38 lakh in a honey-trap cyber fraud. Fraudsters befriended him through a fake Facebook profile, threatened him with a criminal case and allegedly extorted money while posing as police officials

candidates.title: Anti-CEC stir: Several detained at NSUI’s ‘living dead’ protest
candidates.excerpt: New Delhi: Several members of the National Students’ Union of India (NSUI) were allegedly detained during their symbolic “living dead” protest near their headquarters at Raisina Road on Monday, October 5, demanding the resignation and arrest of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. candidates.title: Two Killed, One Injured After Bike Rams into Waste Collection Tractor in Husnabad
candidates.excerpt: The accident occurred near Kalyanamastu Shopping Mall on the Hanumakonda Road when a motorcycle carrying three people reportedly rammed into a municipal waste collection tractor parked on the roadside.

candidates.title: Telangana Poll Officials Reject Bulk Form-7 Applications
candidates.excerpt: Election officials in Telangana on Monday said Form-7 applications allegedly submitted in bulk in Goshamahal and Musheerabad assembly constituencies here were rejected.

candidates.title: Hyderabad cybercrime alert: Beware of call-merging OTP fraud
candidates.excerpt: Cybercrime officials have warned of a fraud targeting bank customers through smartphone call-merging features. Fraudsters pose as bank or service officials, persuade victims to merge calls and then obtain OTPs triggered by transactions initiated using information gathered from the victims

candidates.title: Next phase of GST reforms to make compliance easier: PM Modi
candidates.excerpt: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Monday highlighted that the next phase of GST reforms will make compliance easier and improve the refund process, giving businesses greater confidence to invest and grow.

candidates.title: Excise privilege fee revamp puts Telangana bars, restaurants on protest path
candidates.excerpt: The Telangana Bars and Restaurants Association has opposed the Excise department’s proposed revision of privilege fee, citing poor business, and urged the government to withdraw it. The association has also called for outlet closures and sought action against belt shops and permit rooms.
